title: Governance Guard Engine
description: Standalone CLI engine that automates validation of Governance Rules 1-8 across all MCQ packs and scored-case files. Mirrors and extends the governance-guard.js plugin logic into a pre-commit / CI-compatible tool.

RULE_1.name: question_state → REVISION_HISTORY.md pairing
RULE_1.description: Reports question_state distribution per pack. Flags when Certified or In-Audit state exists without a REVISION_HISTORY.md entry.

RULE_2.name: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty
RULE_2.description: String-aware brace-matching extraction detects all DL-008 violations. Returns QID, slot letter, and content snippet.

RULE_3.name: MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md must not be hand-edited
RULE_3.description: Verifies registry file existence and reports that it is generated-only.

RULE_4.name: CorrectChoice changes must include recomputed/verified note
RULE_4.description: Reports ExplanationCorrect coverage rate per pack. Flags when CorrectChoice fields exist without substantive ExplanationCorrect.

RULE_5.name: Max 30 question objects per change-set
RULE_5.description: Reports per-pack object count and estimates batches needed. Does not block writes — that enforcement lives in governance-guard.js.

RULE_6.name: Identity Validation
RULE_6.description: Verifies QuestionID uniqueness, CorrectChoice validity (A-D), Stem presence, and ExplanationCorrect presence.

RULE_7.name: Certification Pool Census
RULE_7.description: Counts Certified items per pack and computes certification rate. Cross-references against CURRENT_BASELINES.md.

RULE_8.name: Structural Readiness
RULE_8.description: Checks parse-gap: compares QuestionID/ItemID marker count against extracted object count. Flags structurally incomplete files.

schema.ruleResults: object — file-keyed results with per-rule violation arrays
schema.overallSummary: object — total files, violations, certified count, PASS/FAIL

options.--json: Output structured JSON instead of console summary
options.--pack: Run against a single pack file only

dependencies.test_governance_guard.js: Test suite (27 tests) — validates detection logic
dependencies.policy_drift_detector.js: Board B — consumed for policy drift detection
dependencies.governance_event_registry.js: Board D — auto-ingest of VIOLATION events

integrationPoints: Pre-commit hook: run before any pack file commit
CI pipeline: run on PR merge to verify zero new DL-008
Session startup (AGENTS.md §9): verify certified count matches baseline
Cross-check against governance-guard.js plugin: result parity audit
testCoverage: All detection functions exported as CommonJS module. Can be tested with: node -e "const G = require('./scripts/governance_guard_engine.js'); const r = G.runEngine(); console.log(r.overallSummary.status);"
